designer-initial.summary: Selected and audited a five-owner cabin air-quality and humidity supervisor with 14 typed interactions, 12 total cases, six scenarios, one policy owner, and clean-confirmation recovery.
questions_for_model: Can PART-04 own and contract the ConfidenceMode pre/post-state transition locally for the invalid-confirming-trusted sequence without PART-05 or the analyzer recomputing raw validity history?
Can CC-08 through CC-12 form a total ordered PART-05 contract partition, including the defensive Trusted-plus-Unknown combinations, while preserving every exact directive/status pair?

Can one root, one behavior-free Process, and five semantic Threads realize exactly 14 semantic interactions as 22 raw port connections while all 16 boundary delegations remain explicitly uncredited generated support?

diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: The selected system excludes temperature, glazing, defrost, heating/cooling, electrical eligibility, energy restriction, and whole-cabin service arbitration; it instead qualifies air-quality and humidity observations through a dedicated confidence-state owner and makes one air-treatment decision using humidity-over-filtration priority plus clean-confirmation recovery.

model-review.summary: All five owners are nonidentity, all three realizability questions are resolved, and the exact 5/14/12/6 allocation can proceed unchanged.

findings.evidence: PART-01 has output fibers 2/1/1 over four preference/value-validity pairs; PART-02 has fibers 2/1/1 over four air/value-validity pairs; PART-03 has fibers 3/1/1/1 over six humidity/value-validity pairs. Each combines independent validity with a domain value and is not extensionally a one-to-one enum or code rename.

PART-04 maps 24 assessment/pre-state valuations with unknown-input collapse and a state-dependent Confirming versus Trusted distinction; PART-05 maps 108 intent/assessment/confidence valuations through preference, fault, recovery, inconsistency, humidity, and air-quality priority to atomic directive/status pairs. Neither owner preserves, bundles, reroutes, or renames assigned inputs.

Trusted Isolette forms and a fresh current Sireum check support Thread-local state, initialize, compute_cases, In(pre-state), typed DataPort/PortConnection flows, and System-to-Process-to-Thread containment; the check exited 0 with Well-formed against library revision 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1.
findings.requested_change: No Designer allocation change; generate PART-04 with one local confidence state, use In(confidenceMode) in CC-06/CC-07, and constrain confidence output plus post-state locally in CC-05..CC-07 without downstream history reconstruction.

findings.evidence: Eight boundary interactions each require two behavior-free delegation declarations and six internal interactions each require one sibling-Thread declaration, giving exactly 16 + 6 = 22 raw PortConnection declarations, one support Process, five semantic Threads, physical depth two, six non-root usages, and fourteen semantic interactions.
findings.requested_change: No Designer allocation change; mark the Process and sixteen boundary delegations generated-support, give them no owner or semantic credit, and preserve all PART-01..PART-05 and INT-01..INT-14 identities.

findings.evidence: The analyzer can directly enumerate owner-local spaces of 4, 4, 6, 24, and 108 valuations plus exactly 192 composed boundary/pre-state snapshots and six short scenario families. The selected trace paths are closed, and the non-executable/physical claim boundary remains explicit.

designer-resolution.summary: Model findings accepted as compatible with the unchanged 5/14/12/6 baseline; generation authorized.

model-generation.summary: Localized JSON protocol-only repair: normalized assessor and confidence-guardian ownership roles to campaign-v1 applicability in metrics and the retained analyzer; reran the ownership validator, bounded analyzer, independent SysML typecheck, and cross-artifact consistency checks with source semantics, small counts, trace associations, and contracts unchanged. visualization.summary: Validated system overview accepted with readable canonical boundary labels, generated support shown as containment, and zero crossings or route-object collisions.

designer-final.summary: Source, bounded semantics, ownership, traceability, and rendered artifact are fit; the non-executable profile remains not-run.
